questions.text: Which third parties does the file identify, what did each supply, install, operate or maintain, and when?
What evidence supports or weakens a connection between each party’s involvement and the loss, and what other causes do the sources identify?
Which parts, photographs, inspection records or test results are documented, and what does the file say about their location or custody?
Which contracts, work orders, warranties or releases describe a party’s responsibilities, and what do the relevant passages say?
What loss amounts, payments, deductibles or recoveries are documented, in which currency, and which figures are still estimates?
Who has been notified about a possible recovery, when, and what responses, commitments or deadlines appear in the correspondence?
Which unresolved facts or missing records matter to the recovery investigation, and what follow-up and outcomes are documented?
